purpose: Source the historical and semantic genealogy behind the project's Cow -> Milk -> Farm -> Dog/Farmer -> Tree of Strife -> Moloch crosswalk while preserving a strict boundary between public history, adversarial subculture archives, legal records, scholarship, user-reported anecdotes and Potatoverse interpretation.
epistemic_rules: Historical or subcultural vocabulary can illuminate project symbolism without proving supernatural identity or occult practice.
A real person's role is relation-and-time specific; do not turn Guard Dog, Farmer, Cow or Moloch into permanent factual identities.
Adversarial archives may establish provenance of terms or lead to primary material but require corroboration for contested biographical claims.
A user-reported paraphrase remains an attestation until its primary recording/post is recovered.
Legal entity records establish ownership/organization facts within their jurisdiction; they do not establish responsibility for every user's conduct.
Complaint allegations, platform statements and journalistic descriptions retain their own procedural/source status.

sources.author: George C. Heider
sources.title: Moloch — The Oxford Handbook of Biblical Monsters
supports: Biblical mōlek/Moloch is an ancient cultic category with a substantial scholarly debate over deity versus sacrificial-type interpretations.
Child-sacrifice and Tophet traditions are central to the historical discussion.
sources.boundary: Does not support claims that modern internet communities literally worship Moloch.

sources.author: Scott Alexander
sources.title: Meditations on Moloch
supports: Moloch used as a personification of destructive coordination failures and multipolar traps.
The essay explicitly contrasts a trap with a Garden/Gardener solution.
sources.boundary: A philosophical metaphor, not an empirical diagnosis of any named person or organization.

sources.title: lolcow
supports: Etymology is lol + cow, suggesting a person who can be 'milked for laughs' analogous to cash cow.
Cited use exists by 2007.
sources.boundary: A derogatory slang definition, not a judgment that any particular person deserves exploitation.

sources.title: CWCki Forums
supports: CWCki Forums' primary purpose was discussion/speculation about Chris Chan.
The forum accumulated hundreds of thousands of posts and thousands of posters.
The archive states ownership later passed to Null/Joshua Moon and that in 2015 it was consolidated into Kiwi Farms with a broader lolcow focus.
sources.boundary: Useful for insider terminology/provenance; hostile/ironic framing requires caution for biographical judgments.

sources.title: Kiwi Farms
supports: The archive describes Joshua Moon taking over hosting/management of the CWCki Forums and later rebranding the expanded forum as Kiwi Farms.
Preserves the Chris-focused predecessor relation.

sources.title: Null / Joshua Conner Moon
supports: The archive says Moon acted in spring 2018 as a volunteer advisor in a group called the Guard Dogs.
It describes actions intended to reduce troll/manipulator access to Chris, including attempted reporting, email filtering and advice.
sources.boundary: Supports term/role provenance in this specific episode; not a general moral classification of Moon.

sources.title: Guard Dogs
supports: The archive describes a Guard Dogs group including Null that attempted to protect Chris from manipulation by trolls and the Idea Guys.
The same archive records mixed reception and later information leakage by some participants.
sources.boundary: Useful precisely because it demonstrates role inversion/ambiguity rather than a simple permanent villain/protector identity.

sources.title: LOLCOW LLC — Business Entity Details
supports: LOLCOW LLC is active in West Virginia.
Joshua Moon is listed as organizer and member.
KIWI FARMS is listed as a trade name/DBA.
Florida and Wyoming Lolcow LLC entities merged into the West Virginia entity on 2026-03-27.
sources.boundary: Entity/ownership evidence only; does not impute user conduct to the LLC/member.

sources.publisher: U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York via Justia
sources.title: Lolcow LLC v. Fong-Jones, No. 1:2026cv02059
supports: Lolcow LLC is the plaintiff and Zhen Elizabeth Fong-Jones the defendant/counterclaimant in the federal action filed March 12, 2026.
Nature of suit is copyright / declaratory judgment.
On August 27, 2026 the court granted motions to quash Fong-Jones' DMCA subpoenas and denied Lolcow LLC's preliminary-injunction motion.
sources.boundary: Corrects any project record that reverses party direction or describes the action simply as a harassment/defamation suit.

sources.publisher: U.S. District Court for the District of Utah via Justia
sources.title: Greer v. Moon et al., Document 453
supports: The operative Greer action is based on copyright-infringement claims.
The court identifies Joshua Moon and Lolcow LLC as Kiwi Farms defendants and denied the motion to dismiss.
sources.boundary: Denial of dismissal is not a merits finding and should not validate unrelated allegations.

sources.title: Blocking Kiwifarms
supports: Cloudflare terminated security services after describing an escalating emergency and immediate threat to human life.
sources.boundary: Provider risk assessment, not a judicial finding that the site caused a particular death.

sources.title: The endless battle to banish the world's most notorious stalker website
supports: Documents infrastructure/deplatforming conflict and attempts by activists/providers to remove Kiwi Farms from upstream services.
Reports Moon built greater network independence, including operating as an internet service provider/peer.
sources.boundary: Journalistic description of controversial conduct; individual criminal liability requires separate legal evidence.

sources.title: NGL case and 2026 refund process
supports: FTC/Los Angeles DA action provides a regulator-tested comparison for anonymous-messaging safety, youth marketing, platform representations and monetization.
The stipulated order bans offering anonymous messaging apps to users under 18 and contains monetary relief; the complaint allegations and order obligations must remain distinct.
FTC opened/refined consumer refund administration in 2026.
sources.boundary: NGL is a comparison case, not evidence of a connection to Kiwi Farms.

unresolved_attestations.paraphrase: Josh Moon said he had been 'sold to Moloch by the government' or words to that effect.
unresolved_attestations.search_result: No reliable primary recording/post recovered in the September 12, 2026 web pass.
unresolved_attestations.use_rule: May be preserved as an anecdotal attestation and research lead, but must not be presented as a verified quotation or as evidence of occult belief, confession, government trafficking, or psychological transformation.
